# Proxy Advisor Reliance

This section discusses the role of proxy advisors in mutual fund voting. In this section, we first
describe the regulatory background and then turn to the evidence. The following paragraphs explain
why the question matters.

Funds that subscribe to ISS vote with its recommendation on 92 percent of contested items, against
71 percent for funds that do not subscribe (Table 2). The gap is widest for small fund families.

As discussed above, proxy advisors play an important role. In summary, this section has reviewed
the background and the evidence on proxy advisor reliance. We now turn to the policy implications.
